title: Recover a partial customer return and exchange without reversing a shared receipt
user_instruction: Two of the ten FIELD-TABLET-A tablets were confirmed defective in the recorded return inspection. Accept and return only those two units, complete the already approved exchange order for two FIELD-TABLET-B tablets, apply the customer credit to the exchange invoice, and ensure the reverse-pickup event is delivered exactly once. Preserve the other eight tablets, both FIELD-ROUTER-X routers, the unaffected router invoice, and the submitted shared customer Payment Entry.

ambiguous_operation.operation: submit the draft partial customer Sales Return Delivery Note
ambiguous_operation.surface_result: HTTP connection lost before a success response
